episode.episode: 7-17-26 - Hour 4 - How will the new 5 and 5 rule affect college football recruiting and BYU football?
episode.showDescription: Cougar Sports with Ben Criddle (@criddlebenjamin) keeps you up-to-date on all things BYU Sports. We not only cover football & basketball, but we dive into recruiting, baseball, soccer, and more. For insight that you can't get anywhere else, tune into 103.9/ 98.3 FM. Monday-Friday from 2-6 PM MST. Follow us on social media @espnthefan & interact with us using #ESPNTheFan.

transcript_window.text: He came in as a PWL project player, and he only lasted, I want to say, a few weeks, man, before he was out of BYU.

I don't know what happened, why it happened, but he bounced back to JUCO, wended his way through the JUCO ranks, ended up at a few other schools, but Victory Vaca, now a senior defensive tackle transfer who played at BYU once upon a time.
Our heart goes out to him.
Just weeks after losing his mother, two months after this, Sarah Matale, his mother, passed away on April 2nd.
And three weeks after the funeral, Vaca learned that the Hilltoppers were canceling his scholarship.
I was shocked, Vaca told CBS Sports.
Vaca had returned to his home to grieve and planned to rejoin the team for the 2026 season.
